title: The Concept of Anomie in Modern Society
text:
Anomie, a term popularized by Émile Durkheim, refers to a state of normlessness or deregulation within society. It occurs when established social norms are unclear, contradictory, or rapidly changing, leaving individuals without clear guidance regarding acceptable behavior and life goals.

Periods of rapid industrial change, economic collapse, or profound social upheaval often precipitate anomic conditions. In such times, the collective moral framework that previously held society together weakens. This weakening can lead to increased rates of alienation, despair, and unpredictable individual behavior as people struggle to redefine their place within a shifting social structure.
